messages:
Noah Park: Heads-up — LumenX (market insights startup) asked for a hosted embeddings pilot concession. They claim ~40M embeddings over 60 days and want a per-token override.
Anika Rao: rough tokens? are these 768-dim embeddings?
Noah Park: yes 768-dim, average input ~256 tokens -> est 40M * 256 = ~10.24B tokens.
Samir Patel: that's sizable on hosted. What are they asking for?
Noah Park: They want $0.025 per 1K tokens for embeddings for the pilot and ask to waive the standard $5k min. Pilot length 60 days.
Samir Patel: our public embedding list is $0.10 per 1K tokens. Dropping to $0.025 is a 75% cut — below any pilot floor we can accept without approvals.
Anika Rao: finance policy: pilot discounts >25% need Deal Desk + RevOps VP signoff. Also we don't waive min for that scale without deposit or legal addendum.
Noah Park: They said procurement can't do deposits for pilots. Can we propose a staged tier instead?
Samir Patel: suggest: first 200M tokens @$0.03/1K, next 1B @$0.07/1K, remainder @$0.095/1K + require a $25k refundable pilot hold or auto-convert to 2-month commit at $0.07/1K.
Anika Rao: add operational guardrails: usage caps, per-minute throttles, and prefix caching to keep cost predictable. Also offer to enable Dedicated evaluation if they want guaranteed throughput.
Noah Park: customer pref is hosted for simplicity. They want minimal legal friction.
Samir Patel: I'll file a Deal Desk case. Need concise ask: customer, pilot window, est tokens, requested rate, waive min? rep rec, risk.
Noah Park: copy for DD form: "LumenX  - 60d pilot - est 10.24B tokens - requested embeddings rate $0.025/1K - request waive $5k min - rep rec: tiered concession: $0.03/1K first 200M, $0.07/1K next 1B, $0.095/1K thereafter + $25k refundable hold OR auto-convert to 2mo commit at $0.07/1K. Include caps and throttles."
deal-desk-bot: Case opened DD-40112. Routing to @Anika Rao and @CFO-Jordan for funding approval. Attach cost model and expected revenue impact.
CFO-Jordan: preliminary view: 10.24B @ list would be ~$1,024,000 (0.0001/token). The tiered structure with $25k hold reduces risk. Will only approve if legal signs addendum limiting exposure and if we cap daily usage.
Samir Patel: noted. Anika, can you add short cost model to DD thread (compute buckets & expected revenue under rep rec)?
Anika Rao: on it. I'll include savings at each bucket and ROI for hosting.
Noah Park: I'll push the tiered + refundable hold option with LumenX and check if they will accept auto-convert commit instead of a hold.
Samir Patel: thanks team. I'll update DD-40112 when we have decision. :thumbsup:
